summary: Frontend regression test for Paper Hoof homepage changes. All 4 requested changes verified working: (1) 'We Design Everything' pill + dock zone + modal fully removed (no .design-categories-trigger / .footer-docked-rectangle, text absent). (2) Navbar 'Work' link hidden at scrollY=0, appears after scroll >20px, clicking navigates to /work. (3) Hero shows single hero-scroll-arrow with no circle, no dots (.hero-indicators = 0), no 'See Selected Projects' text; clicking smooth-scrolls to Recent Projects (scrollY 0->1080). (4) <html>.is-scrolling toggles correctly: false when idle, true immediately on scroll, false ~700-900ms after scroll stops. Regression checks pass: hero BURROWED renders, all 6 project cards render, footer wordmark + nav links (HOME/BRAND REVIEW/ABOUT/WORK/CONTACT) present. No console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features verified. Note: footer 'Scroll Up' text exists in code (Footer.jsx line 88) and button is present; innerText check missed it in one run because it was below viewport, but button element is confirmed rendered. Base URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env.
